Chinese, English and Japanese projection form retains its draft; 390px layout fits. External core edit invalidates preview; refresh preserves settings and creates only once.

Both projections enter one scene with inherited configuration and distinct runtime IDs; real Godot player moves 45px while NPC stays still. Source OC, projections, images and definitions remain byte-identical.

Existing projection form locks identity, source and template while editing title, speed, health and image. Preview does not write; conflict retains draft; save changes exactly source + metadata, preserving BOM/CRLF, core and siblings.
Rebuilt real Godot uses the same actor UUID with the new image and speed: player moves 80px, NPC remains unchanged. Old image remains registered for explicit scene overrides.
Reload discovers all three projections under the original OC and the same saved scene; authoring bytes remain unchanged.
